summary: F2 completed seven proposals in three behavior groups and 448 matched Java/Python evaluations, while rejected-response review exposed six proposals that must survive structural repairs. The executed retention repair and one extra bounded reconsideration task now precede source criticism. Eighteen focused tests validate the updated boundaries.
findings: All six invalid proposals remain verbatim with source, request and manifest provenance. No missing scope, tag or assumption is silently filled in; a fresh response must propose any executable replacement.
The pre-F3 implementation, plan and baseline are archived and protected. The revised F3 cap is 24 calls, with absolute new-grant ceiling 146; no ledger reset or additional grant.
Two English critiques follow recovery, then a separately sourced Chinese comparison. Source edition equivalence and precedence remain unadjudicated.
Generation concerns, deferred proposals and critic uncertainty trigger up to two further generation/audit cycles. Questions and history cannot disappear when a later critic agrees.
An executable difference, grounded argument or model agreement is not legal truth. The case-specific business abstraction remains provisional and release eligibility remains false.
